_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.42.0 (pine-lang now tags releases): adds prettified output to /api/v1/eval, matching what /api/v1/build already returned. beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.57.0, which adds a draggable/reorderable tab strip and vertical tab rail, a redesigned Database Connections list, and fixes 'Only apply to MCP server' reverting to off after almost any connection action.
